scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w control-plane" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w control-plane && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w control-plane
